text:
Jordan: Quick post-all-hands note for reliability / incidents follow-up. RCA is live: https://redwood.in/rca/207777. Leaving the condensed asks here so leadership + teams can act.
Priya: Can we have a 1-line executive TL;DR at the top of the thread? execs will skim.
Zoe: Exec TL;DR: brief service degradation due to a KV cache eviction cascade impacting a few hot shards; emergency fallback reduced user impact, full fix requires rebalance + eviction-patch.
Sam: Short timeline for thread: 02:50 alert, 02:58 emergency fallback, 03:18 targeted cache bump, 03:42 full recovery. Root cause: eviction policy mis-triggered under a skewed request mix.
Mei: Added infra observations in the RCA re: shard placement + scheduler behavior that amplified load on a subset of hosts.
Ravi: I'll take the cache safety automation (targeted bump + rollback). Plan: infra flag + metric guardrails + playbook snippet. ETA 4 business days.
Taylor: I'll own the external comms + an enterprise FAQ. Drafting short 3-bullet note + private FAQ. ETA: tomorrow noon; will loop Legal.
Jordan: Leadership asked for two additional deliverables: 1) SLO-triggered decision matrix (fallback vs failover vs scale) and 2) an exec-friendly 2-sentence summary for the next board sync. Who can own each?
Priya: I'll draft the decision matrix and map it to SLOs. Need Sam/Mei for signal names. Draft due in 5 business days.
Sam: I'll enumerate the observability signals (KV cache pressure p95/p99, hot-shard eviction rate, request-shape freq) and attach sample graphs to the RCA today.
IncidentBot: incident:207777 acknowledged 02:50, mitigated 03:18, recovered 03:42. RCA link: https://redwood.in/rca/207777
Jordan: Let's capture concrete action items with owners + due dates. Please ack by replying in-thread.
```
- E1: Cache safety automation (owner: Ravi) — due: 4bd
- E2: SLO decision matrix & thresholds (owner: Priya + Sam) — due: 5bd
- E3: Customer comms + enterprise FAQ (owner: Taylor) — due: 1bd
- E4: Shard rebalance RFC + canary plan (owner: Mei) — due: next sprint
- E5: Exec 2-sentence summary (owner: Jordan) — due: 3bd
- E6: Add KV cache pressure metric + alert (owner: Ravi + Sam) — due: 10d
- E7: CI replay test for repro request shapes (owner: Sam) — due: 2w
```
Sam: Adding E8: a small Redwood Optimize eval to catch regressions from quantized cache paths (owner: Sam) — due: 2w.
Mei: I'll open the rebalance RFC today and include phased rollout + quick rollback steps.
Ravi: Acked E1/E6. Quick question: preferred metric scope — all hosts or GPU-only? I recommend all hosts with host_role tag.
Priya: All hosts. otherwise we risk blind spots in placement skew.
Taylor: For customer-facing text, Legal prefers non-technical language + link to full RCA. Lindsey from Legal, can you confirm? (tagging out-of-thread).
Jordan: Noted. Taylor, keep the customer note to 3 bullets and include the exec TL;DR as a short paragraph for enterprise.
DeployBot: deploy:infra/cache-safety-toggle 2077770220 started by Ravi — staging rollout initiated.
Taylor: Draft comms posted (private link) — tagging Legal and Support. Will share public note after quick review.
Sam: Uploading metric names + sample graphs to RCA now. Also prototyping replay harness tomorrow.
Mei: RFC opened: link added to RCA. Canary plan includes 10% initial rollout with 15m observation window.
Jordan: Thanks all. Please keep progress updates in this thread so I can close items in the all-hands tracker. If you need extra hands, ping @oncall and flag #eng-oncall. :raised_hands:
Mei: Follow-up: I'll post canary smoke test results here once the RFC is reviewed.
Ravi: I'll post PR link for the infra toggle and the playbook snippet later today.
Taylor: Will post the customer note draft here in 6 hours for Lindsey's review.
Priya: I'll start the decision matrix doc and tag Sam/Mei for signal inputs.
Jordan: Closing — appreciate the quick ownership.
